title: Sam Did Not Quit
lines: Sam and Dad dig in the hot sun.
"Can I quit?" said Sam. "It is hot."
"Do not quit yet," said Dad. "Dig a bit."
Sam digs and taps a tin box!
Sam tugs at the lid and it pops up.
A map is in the box!
Sam and Dad sit and look at the map.

questions.ask: What was in the tin box?
questions.listenFor: A map. It is said in the story. Have your child find the line and read it back so they can show you they know.

questions.ask: Why did Sam want to quit?
questions.listenFor: Digging was hard and the sun was hot. Either half of that is a good answer.

questions.ask: Have you ever wanted to stop in the middle of a hard job? What happened?
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Sam wanted to quit in line two and kept going. You are linking that to their own day.
